adjudication.rationale: The diff adds nontrivial update logic in TopicEmbed.import: when an embed exists it only revises the post if content_sha1 changed, and then updates embed.content_sha1 via update_column (app/models/topic_embed.rb, else-branch and `if content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1`). The spec’s update test (`Supports updating the post`) only asserts `post.cooked` matches `/new contents/`, which would still pass even if the sha tracking were broken (e.g., embed.content_sha1 not updated) because the post revision happens before the sha update. Also, the no-op path when `content_sha1` is unchanged is not covered by any test in the added spec, as the finding states.
